# java.library options: custom source and resource directories, `release`,
# `flags` and `output`, a resources-only library, a reproducible jar, and a
# missing source directory named explicitly.
[!exec:javac] skip

bit lib assets
stdout 'lib ✔ ok'
stdout 'assets ✔ ok'
exists out/lib-custom.jar
! exists lib/build

# `release = 17` compiles to class file version 61, and `-parameters` keeps
# parameter names.
exec javap -v -cp out/lib-custom.jar demo.Util
stdout 'major version: 61$'
stdout 'MethodParameters'
stdout 'greeting'

# Both source directories and the resource directory reach the jar, and the
# default directories, which this library doesn't use, don't.
exec jar tf out/lib-custom.jar
stdout '^demo/Util\.class$'
stdout '^demo/Extra\.class$'
stdout '^config/app\.properties$'
! stdout 'Ignored'
! stdout 'ignored\.txt'

# A library of resources alone is a jar of them.
exec jar tf assets/build/assets.jar
stdout '^static/index\.html$'
! stdout '\.class$'

# Nothing changed, nothing runs.
bit lib assets
! stdout '✔ ok'

# Building again from scratch gives an identical jar, its entries dated
# 1980 rather than when they were built.
exec unzip -l out/lib-custom.jar
stdout '01-01-1980 00:00   demo/Util\.class$'
! stdout '[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-20[0-9]{2}'
cp out/lib-custom.jar first.jar
bit --force lib
stdout 'lib ✔ ok'
# The runner's cmp reads text, so the system's compares the binary jars.
exec cmp out/lib-custom.jar first.jar

# A source directory named explicitly must exist.
! bit missing
stderr 'sources directory `nowhere` does not exist'

-- BUILD.bit --
explicit lib = java.library {
  dir       = "lib"
  sources   = ["java", "more"]
  resources = "conf"
  release   = 17
  flags     = ["-parameters"]
  output    = "../out/lib-custom.jar"
}

explicit assets = java.library {
  dir = "assets"
}

explicit missing = java.library {
  dir     = "lib"
  sources = ["java", "nowhere"]
  output  = "build/missing.jar"
}
-- lib/java/demo/Util.java --
package demo;

public class Util {
    public static String greet(String greeting) {
        return greeting + " " + Extra.name();
    }
}
-- lib/more/demo/Extra.java --
package demo;

class Extra {
    static String name() {
        return "world";
    }
}
-- lib/conf/config/app.properties --
name=world
-- lib/src/main/java/demo/Ignored.java --
package demo;

class Ignored {
    does not compile
}
-- lib/src/main/resources/ignored.txt --
ignored
-- assets/src/main/resources/static/index.html --
<html></html>
